answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each agent to post a small refundable bond before it can trade, and slashing that bond when independent peers prove the same operator runs an echo chamber of clones. A raven-style audit trail of signed receipts for every completed job, reviewed at dawn each epoch, makes duplicates visible: one real agent keeps its bond and history, while a flood of fresh copies must each pay, wait, and risk losing its stake before gaining any influence.
